channel.title: SircusCo: Funny Christmas Shirts
channel.description: Funny Christmas shirts and sweatshirts: festive animals, cookie swaps, ugly sweater parties, holiday traditions and inside jokes.

item.title: Ugly Christmas Sweater Party T-Shirt for Office Contest Winners
item.description: This ugly Christmas shirt turns the big joke into a bragging right, with a trophy badge that steals the show. It is a funny Christmas shirt for the person who shows up ready for the laugh, the cheer, and the crown at an ugly sweater party.

item.title: Ugly Sweater Contest T-Shirt for Holiday Party Winners
item.description: A bold trophy badge makes this ugly sweater contest tee feel like a magazine cover for the one who takes the win. Wear it to a Christmas party when you want a funny Christmas tee that looks like the title belongs to you.

item.title: Dog Hair Is Basically Tinsel Shirt for Dog Lovers
item.description: This dog hair design turns everyday shedding into a holiday laugh, with a happy pup and a tree dressed in fur garland. It makes a playful dog lover gift for dog moms, dog dads, and anyone who knows the whole house gets decorated by the dog.

item.title: Raccoon Christmas T-Shirt for Animal Lovers and Quirky Friends
item.description: This raccoon Christmas tee shows a sleepy, happy raccoon wrapped in oversized lights with cozy chaos energy. It makes a fun animal lover Christmas gift for quirky coworkers, teens, and friends who want a funny holiday tee for gift swaps or casual winter plans.

item.title: Funny White Elephant T-Shirt for Coworkers and Gift Swap Friends
item.description: Made for the person who shows up with the best gag gift, this funny white elephant design leans into the bit with a self-aware elephant and bold prize rosette. It works as a gift for coworker, a casual holiday exchange pick, or a group shirt for everyone in on the joke.

item.title: Funny Christmas Dog Hair Crewneck Sweatshirt for Holiday Parties
item.description: A happy golden dog in a Santa hat shakes off a fluffy fur cloud that drapes like tinsel next to a small Christmas tree. This Christmas dog crew is made for cozy nights, parties, and anyone who wants a soft laugh about life with a shedding dog.

item.title: White Elephant Gift Exchange Crewneck Sweatshirt for Holiday Swaps
item.description: This white elephant gift exchange crewneck sweatshirt shows a proud little elephant in a Santa hat, clutching a present like it already won. It is a cozy pick for office gift exchange nights, Secret Santa, and December gatherings where a Christmas gag gift gets the biggest laugh.

item.title: Funny Raccoon Christmas Crewneck Sweatshirt for Holiday Parties
item.description: A front-facing raccoon sits tangled in holiday lights with cocoa in paw, making this the kind of funny holiday crewneck you reach for all season. The Cozy Chaos Season design is perfect for holiday parties, white elephant swaps and anyone who wants a warm, silly woodland look.

item.title: Funny Christmas Dog Hair T-Shirt for Dog Moms and Dog Dads
item.description: A fluffy golden dog in a tiny Santa hat shakes off a cloud of fur that looks like tinsel beside a little Christmas tree. This dog Christmas shirt is a cheerful joke for anyone living with a shedding dog, and a funny dog Christmas choice for holiday gatherings or gift exchanges.

item.title: White Elephant Gift Exchange T-Shirt for Holiday Party Prizes
item.description: This white elephant gift exchange T-shirt features a smug gray elephant in a Santa hat, holding a wrapped present and wearing a prize rosette. It is a funny Christmas gift for office parties, Secret Santa swaps, and family exchanges when you want the joke to be obvious at first glance.

item.title: Funny Raccoon Christmas T-Shirt for Holiday Party Gift Givers
item.description: A chunky raccoon in holiday lights holds a mug of cocoa and brings the Cozy Chaos Season mood to your holiday party. This funny Christmas animal tee is a cute raccoon shirt for anyone who likes woodland humor, easy laughs, and a little December mischief.
